name: BrawlVita
description: A native port of Brawl Stars version 29 (Season 3 Welcome to Starr Park!) for the Playstation Vita.
long_description: BrawlVita is a **native port**, not an emulator: the game's own ARMv7 code runs directly on the Vita's CPU. A loader (in the style of the Vita "so-loader" ports) loads the Android game library, connects it to the Vita's graphics, sound, touch screen and buttons, and a small server built into the app answers the game so it runs without any network.
